tasks.title: Verdict: missing something named — land the harness, drop the duplicated constant/test
tasks.why: r2 settles the contradiction with r1's look (docs/found/look-branch-lane-show-ability-fx-captures-20261108.json: 'the squash visibly pools the bank on the ground, checked by eye'): opening gas-t1.jpg beside gas-t1-plate.jpg here shows the two frames are visually identical — no green cloud, only the same mud/fence/building pixels — and gas-o240.jpg shows nothing at the gas coordinates either, at a distance where a man-sized object is already unreadable. probe.json backs the eye: gas_t1_green_low_share 0.89 of only 28 masked pixels (noise), gas_t1_height_frac -0.0, gas_o240_effect_area_frac 0.027 (the bar is 0.03), all four pose_error_m 0.0, manifest.json's calls_taken 5/5 and 1/1 proving the sim did take every call. r1's picture most likely showed the yellow ability-area marker disc, not the bank. BUT r2 carries CombatFx.Banks.cs:24 (GasBankSquash = 0.55f) and BurstRecipeTests.cs's TheGasBankLiesOnTheGround_NotOverAMansHead as its own copy of r1's already-landed-elsewhere constant and guard test (git diff ability-fx-captures..ability-fx-captures-r2 on CombatFx.Banks.cs: same constant, only the doc-comment and field order differ; same assertions, renamed test) — a straight duplicate that cannot land twice. So r2 is not simply 'finished and worth landing' as-is: what's genuinely new and worth keeping is GasBankStills.cs + probe.py (a plate-subtraction, hue-gated, metres-based measurement nothing else in the repo has, with a --selftest), the four stills+sidecars, and the decisions.md Open row recording the capture-path-vs-look-fault question for the owner. What should NOT land a second time is the GasBankSquash constant and its guard test, since whichever of r1/r2 lands first makes the other a straight rebase conflict on CombatFx.Banks.cs (plan step 4 confirmed this).
